target.scope: All finite declared cases; not all possible futures; no guaranteed floor.
target.primary: S4 euclidean_distance versus equal-weight identical basket
target.mechanism_control: S4 off identical checkpoint and policy

supplemental: All six slow-study windows, all four methods, each listing market separately; never aggregate currencies or call these Laura portfolio evidence. Incomplete market-time grids fail and remain in report.

policy.name: anchored_risk_adjusted_log_signal
policy.small_basket_cap: max(0.15, 1/n) so equal-weight reference remains feasible; no diversification claim for two-stock baskets
policy.holding_accounting: Self-financing long-only post-fee weights; preserve drifted holdings and cash; cost per dollar bought/sold; terminal liquidation charged.
policy.signal: positive log-location divided by risk_aversion*Student-t log-variance; clipped at1; distribute only 20% risk sleeve; not an arithmetic expected-return estimate
policy.seed_ensemble: Equal average of log-location; total variance includes within-seed predictive variance and between-seed location dispersion; no winning seed selection

stress_paths.single_default: one asset loses100% in month1 and remains untradable; other asset returns zero; fixed forecast policy; engineering counterexample only

statistics.endpoint: bootstrap of saved paired log net-wealth increments, conditional policy path; not policy retraining or future coverage
statistics.joint_claim: No support unless all declared primary cases complete and each empirical uplift >=6%; always exploratory.

laura.facility_contribution: not certified; reserve first, then stated buffer; no distribution-free probability
laura.current_calls: research shortlist only pending participant universe/holdings and reviewed policy

new_quant_ml_framework.integration: Strict dated forecast JSON contract; no speculative import from unrelated research projects

limitations: Previously inspected public survivor histories, retrospective adjusted-price proxies, no historical membership or verified executable timestamps.
Costs are sensitivity assumptions, not measured fills. Zero cash return is a declared benchmark assumption.
Source forecasts use a blind month; trading occurs at next month-end under research coordinates. Orders committed from forecast without reacting to later-known observations.
No order placement, public submission or third-party messages.
